name: sugarcraft/sugar-ssh-server
description: SSH server middleware framework — inspired by charmbracelet/wish, developed as a native PHP project. Composable middleware (auth, logging, rate-limiting, channel handling) and a PTY supervisor that runs a shell or a SugarCraft Program under a host OpenSSH daemon's ForceCommand. It does not implement the SSH wire protocol, and it ships no client, no port forwarding and no SFTP server.

suggest.ext-ffi: sugar-pty binds libc through FFI to allocate the PTY; without it the default InProcessTransport cannot run, while the legacy HostSshdTransport needs nothing. sugar-pty's own manifest still hard-requires ext-ffi, so install-time enforcement is transitive.
suggest.ext-pcntl: Forks and reaps the InProcessTransport session child and forwards SIGWINCH resizes; runChild() raises a PtyException when it is missing, and the legacy HostSshdTransport needs nothing.
